# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "fetch_url", "description": "Fetch a web page and return its text content.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"url": {"type": "string", "description": "The full URL to fetch."}}, "required": ["url"]}}}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

steps.content: Both sellers offer identical products at the same price of $129, with the same key features and specifications. The only difference is the retailer: Ottervale Audio is the authorized Quellwyn dealer and includes a full manufacturer warranty, while Brackmoor Sound simply ships the headphones and does not mention any specific warranty. Because the product is the same price and functions the same way, either choice is fine—just pick the retailer that offers the best customer service or has the most convenient return policy for you.
